FACT_ID: sec01-F01 | anchor: A01
An acceleration lane is an extra lane beside a high-speed highway that lets an entering driver build up speed before merging into the through lanes [A01].
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-wv-class-e:west-virginia-division-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0009]

FACT_ID: sec01-F02 | anchor: A01
West Virginia treats a motor vehicle as an antique when it is more than twenty-five years old and is owned only as a collector's item for club events, tours, parades and similar outings rather than for everyday transportation [A01].
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-wv-class-e:west-virginia-division-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0009]

FACT_ID: sec01-F03 | anchor: A01
Authorized emergency vehicles include fire, police, chartered rescue squad and ambulance vehicles together with other emergency vehicles [A01].
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-wv-class-e:west-virginia-division-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0009]

FACT_ID: sec01-F04 | anchor: A01
Blind spots are the zones on both sides of a vehicle that the driver cannot see without turning the head [A01].
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-wv-class-e:west-virginia-division-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0009]

FACT_ID: sec01-F05 | anchor: A01
Blood alcohol concentration measures the alcohol in the bloodstream, and a driver over the age of twenty-one breaks the law by driving at point zero eight percent or higher while a driver under the age of twenty-one breaks it at point zero two percent or higher [A01].
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-wv-class-e:west-virginia-division-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0009]

FACT_ID: sec01-F06 | anchor: A01
A bus is a motor vehicle built to carry more than seven passengers and used mainly to transport people for compensation [A01].
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-wv-class-e:west-virginia-division-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0009]

FACT_ID: sec01-F07 | anchor: A01
A commercial driver is anyone who drives a commercial motor vehicle on public streets or highways for any purpose [A01].
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-wv-class-e:west-virginia-division-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0009]

FACT_ID: sec01-F08 | anchor: A01
A commercial motor vehicle has a gross vehicle weight rating of twenty-six thousand one pounds or more, is built to carry sixteen or more passengers counting the driver, or hauls hazardous materials in any weight class that requires placards [A01].
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-wv-class-e:west-virginia-division-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0009]

FACT_ID: sec01-F09 | anchor: A01
A deceleration lane sits beside the regular lanes so that vehicles leaving the highway can slow down without blocking through traffic [A01].
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-wv-class-e:west-virginia-division-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0009]

FACT_ID: sec01-F10 | anchor: A01
A divided highway carries opposing traffic on separate roadways split by an unpaved strip of land, a raised median or another physical barrier [A01].
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-wv-class-e:west-virginia-division-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0009]

FACT_ID: sec01-F11 | anchor: A01
The handbook calls a driver any person who drives, operates or physically controls a motor vehicle in a place open to the public for vehicular traffic, or who is required to hold a driver's license [A01].
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-wv-class-e:west-virginia-division-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0009]

FACT_ID: sec01-F12 | anchor: A01
A driver's license is a permit or license the state issues that authorizes a person to drive a motor vehicle in a specific class or classes, subject to whatever restriction or endorsement it carries [A01].
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-wv-class-e:west-virginia-division-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0009]

FACT_ID: sec01-F13 | anchor: A01
Driving under the influence means being under the influence of alcohol, drugs or controlled substances while driving any motor vehicle [A01].
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-wv-class-e:west-virginia-division-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0009]

FACT_ID: sec01-F14 | anchor: A01
A farm tractor is a motor vehicle designed and used mainly in agriculture to pull plows, mowing machines and other implements of husbandry [A01].
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-wv-class-e:west-virginia-division-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0009]

FACT_ID: sec01-F15 | anchor: A01
Following distance is the space cushion kept between your vehicle and the one directly ahead of you [A01].
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-wv-class-e:west-virginia-division-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0009]

FACT_ID: sec01-F16 | anchor: A01
The graduated driver's license is a three-phase licensing program for ages fifteen to eighteen that lets young drivers build skill and confidence through safe, measured steps, and each phase has its own requirements and restrictions [A01].
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-wv-class-e:west-virginia-division-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0009]

FACT_ID: sec01-F17 | anchor: A01
A highway is the entire width between the boundary lines of any way that is maintained and open to the public for vehicular travel [A01].
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-wv-class-e:west-virginia-division-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0009]

FACT_ID: sec01-F18 | anchor: A01
An implement of husbandry is a vehicle designed or adapted for agricultural purposes and used by its owner mainly in agricultural operations [A01].
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-wv-class-e:west-virginia-division-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0009]

FACT_ID: sec01-F19 | anchor: A02
Under West Virginia's implied consent law every licensed driver agrees to take a chemical test when charged with driving under the influence, and refusing that test suspends the driving privilege for at least one year [A02].
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-wv-class-e:west-virginia-division-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0010]

FACT_ID: sec01-F20 | anchor: A02
An interchange is a system of connecting roadways with one or more grade separations that moves traffic between two or more roadways on different levels [A02].
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-wv-class-e:west-virginia-division-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0010]

FACT_ID: sec01-F21 | anchor: A02
An intersection is the area two or more highways share where they meet at or close to right angles, even if one highway does not cross the other [A02].
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-wv-class-e:west-virginia-division-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0010]

FACT_ID: sec01-F22 | anchor: A02
A low-speed vehicle is a four-wheeled motor vehicle built and designated as a low-speed vehicle on its manufacturer's certificate of origin, and modified golf carts and ATVs do not qualify [A02].
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-wv-class-e:west-virginia-division-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0010]

FACT_ID: sec01-F23 | anchor: A02
Low-speed vehicles may run only on private roads or on public roads and streets inside a municipality where the speed limit is twenty-five miles per hour or less [A02].
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-wv-class-e:west-virginia-division-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0010]

FACT_ID: sec01-F24 | anchor: A02
Merging traffic means vehicles entering moving traffic lanes from the adjacent lanes on the left or right [A02].
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-wv-class-e:west-virginia-division-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0010]

FACT_ID: sec01-F25 | anchor: A02
A moped is a two- or three-wheeled cycle with foot pedals and an independent power source of at most two horsepower, an engine no larger than fifty cubic centimeters and a top speed of thirty miles per hour [A02].
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-wv-class-e:west-virginia-division-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0010]

FACT_ID: sec01-F26 | anchor: A02
A motorcycle is a motor vehicle other than a tractor that has a seat for the rider and is designed to travel on no more than three wheels touching the ground [A02].
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-wv-class-e:west-virginia-division-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0010]

FACT_ID: sec01-F27 | anchor: A02
A motor-driven cycle is a motorcycle, including any motor scooter, whose motor does not exceed two hundred fifty cubic centimeters, and mopeds are excluded from the term [A02].
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-wv-class-e:west-virginia-division-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0010]

FACT_ID: sec01-F28 | anchor: A02
A motor vehicle is any self-propelled vehicle that does not run on rails [A02].
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-wv-class-e:west-virginia-division-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0010]

FACT_ID: sec01-F29 | anchor: A02
An operator is a person who drives a motor vehicle, has actual physical control of it, or steers a vehicle that a motor vehicle is towing on a highway [A02].
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-wv-class-e:west-virginia-division-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0010]

FACT_ID: sec01-F30 | anchor: A02
A pedestrian is any person traveling on foot [A02].
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-wv-class-e:west-virginia-division-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0010]

FACT_ID: sec01-F31 | anchor: A02
Revocation means a driver's license and all driving privileges on public highways are terminated and cannot be renewed, though in certain circumstances the DMV may accept and act on an application for a new license [A02].
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-wv-class-e:west-virginia-division-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0010]

FACT_ID: sec01-F32 | anchor: A02
Right-of-way is the privilege of using the highway immediately [A02].
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-wv-class-e:west-virginia-division-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0010]

FACT_ID: sec01-F33 | anchor: A02
The roadway is the part of a highway that is improved, designed or ordinarily used for vehicle travel, not counting the berm or shoulder [A02].
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-wv-class-e:west-virginia-division-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0010]

FACT_ID: sec01-F34 | anchor: A02
A school bus is a motor vehicle, owned by a public agency or privately owned and operated, that carries children to or from school [A02].
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-wv-class-e:west-virginia-division-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0010]

FACT_ID: sec01-F35 | anchor: A02
Suspension means a driver's license and all driving privileges on public highways are withdrawn only temporarily [A02].
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-wv-class-e:west-virginia-division-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0010]

FACT_ID: sec01-F36 | anchor: A02
A wireless communications device is a handheld device used to reach a wireless telephone service, or a text messaging device [A02].
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-wv-class-e:west-virginia-division-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0010]
